name: settings-core-values
description: The page refuses a snapshot whose common settings hold a value outside its declared form, reads a snapshot without stored settings, reports the trace switch as off, and applies the settings of a start document whose values have their declared form.
reason: The reply of the call workspace with the kind snapshot is the state of the registry, which the Go producer builds no project for (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#limits), and the calls setTheme, setMenuLanguage and performance apply to the window of the native host, which the producer does not run.
